QuestInfo.0:
Defeat 100 stunned monsters moved by a White Hole skill within 30 minutes.
Wormholes are created using the Black Hole and White Hole skills. Enemies that enter the Black Hole travel through a wormhole and exit from the White Hole.
To obtain the requisite skills, equip special equipment obtained in the Quanah world.
